about_the_game:
Give your guardian of the underworld a fitting castle with the KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palaces series with a flaming set of MV/MZ-sized tiles that’ll make your heroes think they’ve entered the molten core of the world. Have your heroes carefully cross blackened bridges over rivers of lava and climb ladders to avoid the glowing gaze of 3-headed dog statues, or let your heroes race up the stairs and battle every guard in the way to reach the throne room! Stump your heroes with magic circles that teleport them to new locations in the castle, and create puzzles where your heroes need to push crystals into the right spots so that they’ll light up and unlock treasure chests.

A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with a B sheet are filled with burning and charred tiles to help you create dungeon hallways and rooms for your heroes to explore. Floors and walls in black and orange can help lead your heroes to the main throne room with herringbone patterns, or switch from orange tiles to black where lava has pooled in the room and darkened the floor with soot. Stud the walls top thin pillars with orange crystals and remind your heroes that a challenging fight awaits them with statues of monstrous dogs staring from alcoves in the hallways. This pack also includes a black and orange treasure chest character sprite so that your heroes can be rewarded for exploring the lava-filled corridors or solving tricky puzzles based on lighting up the palace’s crystal lamps. Check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset and add a new infernal dungeon for your heroes to conquer!


The Cerberus Tileset Includes:


Ground Tiles:

Lots of lava
Four types of flooring (concrete, tile, fancy and herringbone) in dark gray and orange
Various spike traps and holes


Walls:

Wall tiles to match floor tiles.


Also featuring:

stairs to match flooring
small accent pillars
large accent pillars (plain and themed)
plain arch
detailed arch
raised platform
coordinated throne
jeweled wall decor
treasure chest (with animated version)
push block
bridge rails
multiple statues – large and small
magic rings
diagonal stairs
3 designs of ladders
plus more!


Events and Animations:

Treasure chest with lit and unlit versions


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
